Done. The merge passed on the first execution.

- **Artifact**: `out/T4/solution.py`, a plain safetensors + torch script. It reassembles the sharded base from its index, verifies all three checkpoints share the same names, checks the 66 non-MLP tensors are bit-exact identical across base, ft1 and ft2, then computes each of the 48 MLP tensors as base plus 0.4 times each task vector against the unmodified base, in float32.
- **Checks enforced**: name-set equality, exactly 48 MLP matches spanning layers 0 to 15, bit-exact shared tensors, merged count of 48, output count of 114, and a reload of the written file that re-verifies names, shapes, dtypes and that unchanged tensors equal the base. Every failure exits with an error.
- **Output**: `out/T4/model.safetensors` with 114 tensors, about 5.1 GB.
- **Report**: `out/T4/REPORT.md` written with the self-report fields. One execution, no failures. I skipped mergekit because its task arithmetic would not enforce the precondition or the count checks, so a wrapper script would have been needed regardless.
